senses.gloss: 1. ऌ the ninth vowel of the alphabet (resembling the sound ल्र्य् in रेवेल्र्य्; it only appears in some forms of √ कॢप्).
the earth, the mother of the gods, L.
1. ॡ the tenth vowel of the alphabet (the corresponding long vowel to ऌ, entirely artificial and only appearing in the works of some grammarians and lexicographers).
ॡ f. the mother of the cow of plenty
